description: Image Description: The image features two toothbrushes positioned side by side, with their bristles pointing upward and handles resting in a container that is partially visible at the bottom of the frame. The toothbrush on the left has a dark teal handle with a white grip section near the base, while its bristles are arranged in a pattern of green, blue, and white. The toothbrush on the right has a bright pink handle with a lime green bristle head, featuring bristles in alternating shades
